title: 第八百七十八章 好时代和坏时代第八百七十七章 出人意料
lines: 楚宽已经很久没有体会到如此挫败的滋味了。而这种挫败并不是所谓的打不过，斗不过，毕竟按照现在的情势来看，哪怕阿六再能打也不过是一个人，外头的御前近侍也是因为没有得到他的指令，于是没贸贸然闯进来而已。
可是，张寿从刚刚的说到现在的做，种种言行举止全都出乎意料，再加上赵国公朱泾又在旁边说一些动摇他的话，哪怕他只是生出一点点对自己这破釜沉舟之举的质疑，那也是这难缠的翁婿俩最大的成功。
然而，既然已经不惜把某些事对赵国公朱泾剖析得明明白白，楚宽当然不会就此退缩。朱泾这样的人，说话做事稳重到犹如文官，他不用担心人会大嘴巴满世界宣扬。如果没有他强行要见张寿这一遭，也许朱泾就连对皇帝也要斟酌许久之后才会选择性透露一些他的话。
可做都做了，他从来不会为做过的事情后悔。再加上如今各种心愿一一了却，最大的祸害也一个个铲除，他已经谈不上多大的牵挂了，生死既然都置之度外，大逆不道，罪该万死都无所谓了，他还有什么好迟疑的？
因此，楚宽稍稍退后了两步，见阿六也退到了张寿身前，他就淡淡地说：“张学士说得也许没错，我确实应该学一学。可是，一个九章堂便那般艰难，一座公学更是引来攻谮无数，你那新学的倡议一说就引起那么绝大的反弹，你觉得学海无涯，可天下腐儒却能淹死你！”
“传说太祖初年，天下有官营的药局和医士，保证无钱的贫民能够得到医治；天下有数不清的官学和义学，能够让贫儿能够读书；天下还有不计其数的官营善堂，能够让民间再无冻饿而死的弃儿，而且但凡生而不举，或溺死或活埋的残忍父母，全都会得到严惩……”
“而所有的这些，全都是因为驱除鞑虏后，官府囤积了大量无主田地分发贫民，又收拢无数财富作为后备，方才能够做到。如今，天下承平已久，纵使由外而内的大位更迭发生过两次，但清洗掉的不过一批曾经的高官权臣，那些盘踞在各地的缙绅地主却依旧越来越富。”
张寿虽说被阿六扶了起来，但此时听着楚宽这些话，他却禁不住有些牙疼。看来楚宽的病比预想中更重啊，这是扳不回来了？
而正当他想要开口反驳的时候，却听到了自家岳父那低沉的声音。
“太祖皇帝驱除鞑虏，恢复天下衣冠，确实是古今少有的明君贤主，但你怎么就确定，当时那所谓天下百姓安居乐业的景象，就真的如你现在所说？史家的春秋笔法，古往今来都是一样的，尤其是粉饰圣君明主的时候，更是无所不用其极！”
“就如同《旧唐书》中还好歹略提一提唐太宗的不是，到了《新唐书》，就连他诛凶杀弟的恶行都不提。这还是宋人写唐史，那唐人写唐史，甚至写隋史，岂不是更加荒谬？”
楚宽没想到，平时也算是太祖皇帝推崇者的朱泾，竟会突然如此反驳自己，愣了一愣之后顿时勃然大怒：“什么叫粉饰圣君明主，朱泾，你竟敢如此大逆不道！我朝太祖岂是自矜功劳，口口声声自己献计解了雁门之围的唐太宗能相提并论的？”
朱泾却一点都没有因为楚宽的发怒而退缩，反而不慌不忙地笑了一声。
“从宋末到元末，百余年先是天下战乱，随后又是蒙元一再内乱，盘剥地方，最后又是元末天下战乱，你知道损失了多少人口，你知道多少人流离失所？天下无主田地那么多，你知道有多少是荒地，而要把这些荒地开垦出来，国朝之初，要花费多少人力，迁移多少人口，而因此又有多少人死在路上？”
张寿听到朱泾说战乱，说人口，说迁移，他不禁在心里叹了一口气。
很多人说起哪朝哪代开国，都会赞颂生机勃勃，斗志昂扬，仿佛只凭一股斗志就会有后来的繁华富庶，却压根忘了，无论汉隋，无论宋明，建国初年其实根本就没有那么多歌舞升平，因为天下初定，吃饱饭都不容易，仓廪的日益丰实，那是很多人的牺牲换来的。
就比如朱泾所说的大迁徙，就时下平民百姓骨子里的故土难离情绪来说，有几个人愿意迁徙，尤其是从北到南，从南到北，这种跨地域的大量流动根本就是不可能的。而行政强制性迁徙，一旦在物资补给以及调度上出现问题，路上会死多少人？
最重要的是，明初的百姓，有什么信仰，有什么斗志？
大字不识一个的他们，有几个愿意为朝廷的大政方略牺牲？也不能说是太祖皇帝学朱元璋，在面对天下十室九空的情况下，甭管哪个朝代，不进行大规模人口迁徙，怎么搞建设？
南北人口一旦剧烈失衡，那么科举的及第人数就会持续性失衡，所以就如同后世的大学录取各省分名额一样，在如今这个年头，乡试的解额，也就是举人的数量，同样是个各省规定额度，而在最终会试和殿试录取的时候，也会均衡考虑南北。
须臾，张寿就意识到自己想得远了，却忍不住轻声说道：“兴，百姓苦，亡，百姓苦。”
张寿和朱泾竟然如此一唱一和，楚宽那脸色不可避免地变得狰狞：“天下兴亡，匹夫有责，岂能因愚夫愚妇的抱怨而诋毁明君令主？”
朱泾却并没有理会楚宽，他甚至没有给张寿再次抢过话头的机会，淡淡地继续往下说。
“至于你说的医士和药局，那时候天下初定，百废俱兴，好大夫本来就少，而且所谓杏林的习俗就是敝帚自珍，就算勒令他们收徒教授，很多人也是做个样子。所以很多所谓的医士，不过是认得几个字的书生拿着本医书，装模作样地给人把脉，其实根本不会看病。”
“连脉息都感觉不到，治病当然也就是庸医，至于开方子，那就更是依样画葫芦照抄。但如果这样的话，好歹还能撞大运，几十个人里头治好几个人。但是，你用你自己的脑子好好想一想，天下初定，赋税都还没来得及收上几个钱，朝廷哪里有钱囤积药材？”
“你知道那时候天下有多少生药铺因为这医士和药局制度而破家灭门，你知道那时候天下有多少曾经舍粥放米，少收佃租的良善之家因为要被逼乐输药材，于是家破人亡？天下缙绅不都是吃人不吐骨头的，刚刚躲过战乱再被某些官吏这么一倾轧，他们的活路呢？”
content_en:
Chu Kuan hadn't experienced such frustration for a long time. And this kind of defeat is not the so-called inability to fight. After all, according to the current situation, even if Ah Liu can fight, he can only fight alone. The imperial attendant outside did not rush in because he did not get his order.
However, Zhang Shou's words and deeds from what he just said to what he does now are all unexpected. In addition, Zhao Guogong Zhu Jing said some words to shake him. Even if he only had a little doubt about his desperate move, it would be the biggest success of this difficult son-in-law and father-in-law.
However, since Chu Kuan had already analyzed certain things clearly to Zhao Guogong Zhu Jing, Chu Kuan would certainly not back down. A person like Zhu Jing speaks and acts as steadily as a civil servant. He doesn't have to worry about being loud-mouthed and spreading the word all over the world. If he hadn't forced himself to see Zhang Shou, perhaps Zhu Jing would have considered what he said to the emperor for a long time before selectively revealing some of his words.
But he has done everything, and he never regrets what he has done. In addition, now that all kinds of wishes have been fulfilled one by one, and the biggest scourge has been eradicated one by one, he can no longer talk about how much he cares. Since life and death are ignored, it doesn't matter if he commits treason or deserves death, why should he hesitate?
Therefore, Chu Kuan took two steps back, and seeing Ah Liu also retreating in front of Zhang Shou, he said calmly: "Xueshi Zhang may be right, I really should learn something. However, a Jiuzhangtang is so difficult, and a public school attracts countless attacks. Your initiative to learn new things has caused such a huge backlash. You think there is no limit to the sea of learning, but the corrupt scholars in the world can drown you!"
"It is said that in the early years of Taizu, there were government-run pharmacies and doctors in the world to ensure that poor people with no money could receive medical treatment; there were countless government-run schools and free schools in the world to enable poor children to study; there were also countless government-run charity halls in the world to prevent abandoned children from freezing and starving to death. Moreover, cruel parents who refused to help, drowned or were buried alive would all be severely punished..."
"And all of this was only possible because after expelling the Tartars, the government hoarded a large amount of unowned land to distribute to the poor, and collected countless wealth as a backup. Now, the world has been at peace for a long time. Even though there have been two changes of power from the outside to the inside, only a group of former high-ranking officials and powerful officials have been purged. The gentry and landlords entrenched in various places are still getting richer."
Although Zhang Shou was helped up by Ah Liu, he couldn't help but feel a bit of toothache when he heard Chu Kuan's words. It seems that Chu Kuan's illness is more serious than expected. Is this irreversible?
And just when he was about to retort, he heard the deep voice of his father-in-law.
"Emperor Taizu expelled the Tartars and restored the world's clothes. He was indeed a wise king and sage who is rare in ancient and modern times. But how can you be sure that the so-called scene of people living and working in peace and contentment in the world at that time was really what you say now? The writing style of historians in the Spring and Autumn Period has been the same throughout the ages, especially when whitewashing the saintly king and wise ruler, he went to all possible lengths!"
"Just like the "Old Book of Tang" briefly mentions the faults of Tang Taizong, in the "New Book of Tang", it doesn't even mention his evil deeds of murdering his younger brothers. This is still people from the Song Dynasty writing Tang history, so wouldn't it be even more ridiculous for Tang people to write Tang history, or even Sui history?"
Chu Kuan did not expect that Zhu Jing, who was usually regarded as the admirer of Emperor Taizu, would suddenly refute him like this. He was stunned for a moment and then became furious: "What do you mean by whitewashing the Holy Lord Mingzhu, Zhu Jing, how dare you be so treacherous! How can I, Taizu, be proud of his own merits, and can he be compared to Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty who keeps claiming that he has provided his own plan to solve the siege of Yanmen?"
Zhu Jing, however, did not flinch at all because of Chu Kuan's anger. Instead, he laughed calmly.
"From the end of the Song Dynasty to the end of the Yuan Dynasty, for more than a hundred years, there was first war in the world, then there were repeated civil strife in the Mongolian and Yuan Dynasties, and local exploitation, and finally there was war in the world at the end of the Yuan Dynasty. Do you know how many people were lost, how many people were displaced? There are so many ownerless fields in the world, how much of them are wastelands, and to reclaim these wastelands, at the beginning of the dynasty, how much manpower was spent, how many people were moved, and how many people died on the road?"
Zhang Shou couldn't help but sigh in his heart when he heard Zhu Jing talking about the war, population, and migration.
When many people talk about which dynasty or generation founded the country, they will praise the vitality and high fighting spirit, as if fighting spirit alone will lead to the subsequent prosperity and prosperity. However, they have completely forgotten that in the early years of the founding of the People's Republic of China, no matter the Han, Sui, Song or Ming dynasties, there were not so many songs and dances to promote peace. Because the world was first established, it was not easy to have enough food. The increasing abundance of warehouses was the result of the sacrifices of many people.
Take the Great Migration mentioned by Zhu Jing, for example. In terms of the current sentiment that ordinary people cannot leave their homeland, there are a few people who are willing to migrate, especially from north to south, and from south to north. Such large-scale cross-regional movement is simply impossible. As for administrative forced migration, once there are problems with material supply and scheduling, how many people will die on the road?
The most important thing is, what beliefs did the people in the early Ming Dynasty have and what fighting spirit they had?
How many of them, who are illiterate, are willing to sacrifice for the imperial government's political strategy? It cannot be said that Emperor Taizu imitated Zhu Yuanzhang. Faced with the situation of ten houses and nine empty houses in the world, regardless of which dynasty, how can we carry out construction without large-scale population migration?
Once there is a severe imbalance in the population between the north and the south, the number of people who pass the imperial examination will continue to be out of balance. Therefore, just like the quotas for university admissions in later generations, in today's era, the quota for the provincial examination, that is, the number of candidates, is also a quota specified by each province. In the final admissions for the general examination and the palace examination, the north and the south will be balanced.
After a moment, Zhang Shou realized that he was thinking too far, but he couldn't help but said softly: "In prosperity, the people suffer, in death, the people suffer."
Zhang Shou and Zhu Jing actually sang in harmony like this, and Chu Kuan's face inevitably turned ferocious: "Everyone is responsible for the rise and fall of the world. How can we slander a wise king and his lord because of the complaints of a foolish man and a foolish woman?"
Zhu Jing ignored Chu Kuan. He didn't even give Zhang Shou a chance to take over the conversation again and continued speaking calmly.
"As for the doctors and pharmacies you mentioned, at that time, the world was in a state of peace, all kinds of things were prospering, and there were few good doctors. Moreover, the so-called custom of Xinglin was to cherish the broom. Even if they were ordered to recruit apprentices and professors, many people would just act like it. Therefore, many so-called doctors were just scholars who knew a few words holding a medical book and pretending to check people's pulses. In fact, they did not know how to treat patients at all."
"If you can't even feel your pulse, your treatment is just quackery. As for prescribing prescriptions, you just copy them. But if this is the case, you can still get lucky and cure a few people out of dozens of people. But use your own brain to think about it. The world has been settled, and taxes have not even had time to collect a few dollars. How can the imperial court have the money to hoard medicinal materials?"
"Do you know how many herbal medicine shops in the world were destroyed because of the system of doctors and pharmacies at that time? Do you know how many good families in the world who used to give up rice instead of porridge and collect less rent from tenants were forced to lose their medicinal materials, so their families were ruined? Aren't all the gentry in the world like to eat people without spitting out their bones? They just escaped the war and were squeezed out by some officials like this. What is their way of survival?"
title_en: Chapter 878 Good Times and Bad Times Chapter 877 Unexpected
